summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RY on TSX/NYSE) filed a 6-K announcing a normal course issuer bid to repurchase up to 45 million common shares (~3.24% of shares outstanding as of May 29, 2026) for cancellation, approved by the TSX and OSFI. Purchases may start June 12, 2026, and run until June 11, 2027, at prevailing market prices through TSX, NYSE, and other exchanges, with daily TSX purchases capped at 886,352 shares (25% of average daily volume). An automatic share purchase plan will be used via RBC Dominion Securities. The prior bid concluding June 11, 2026, repurchased 19,168,210 shares at ~C$215.85 average price. This is a straightforward open-market share buyback program for capital management and shareholder return, not a tender offer. Watch for execution pace and market conditions affecting repurchase timing.
